title: ExperienceMomentMetadata
description: App-schema metadata for the experience-moment contentType — one persona's first-person recording of one scenario at one moment in time.

subjectRef.description: CID or slug reference to the subject ContentNode (human or collective).

roleRef.description: CID or slug reference to the role ContentNode.

featureRef.description: CID or slug reference to the feature ContentNode (gherkin feature canonical entry).

scenarioName.description: The scenario name (Scenario: or Scenario Outline: line from the feature file).

scenarioUri.description: Relative path from genesis/a2o/features to the feature file, e.g. 'lamad/learning-paths/path-progression.feature'.

scenarioLine.description: Line number where the scenario starts in the feature file.

commit.description: Git commit SHA (abbreviated 7 chars or full 40 chars).

runId.description: Unique identifier for this test run (e.g., CI build ID or local run timestamp).

errorClass.description: Present when status=failed; classifies the error (e.g., 'AssertionError/timeout', 'NetworkError/503').

sidecarArtifacts.description: References to test artifacts (CIDs or paths).

screenshot.description: Screenshot of failure or key state.

relatedExperienceStory.description: CID or slug reference to the parent experience-story ContentNode.
